title: Single Child | Stand Up Comedy By Trisha Pathak
description:
#standupcomedy #funnyvideos #comedy 

This is my first stand up comedy video, and it jokes about growing up in Bhopal and the oddly funny way people react when they hear where I’m from.

I joke about how Bhopal is still only remembered for the Bhopal Gas Tragedy, even though it’s a genuinely beautiful place known as the City of Lakes.

The second half of the video is about what it’s like being a single child. I break the stereotype that single children are always pampered or spoiled. I joke about the reality of growing up without siblings. Turns out, being a single child doesn’t mean you’re alone, it just means your parents become your siblings.

Don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe if this made you laugh. More stand up comedy videos coming soon. Also, drop a comment if you liked it!🎤😄
